Reviews

What customers say.

5 out of 5 on every rated review.

01Rip out and re‑fit of en‑suite, bathroom and downstairs WC

Dan has worked on two bathroom and one downstairs cloakroom projects at our house. Dan was very helpful in the design phase, advising on layout, tiles and fittings. Dan is very thorough and completes work to a very high standard.

Dan was friendly, reliable and completed the work on time and within original budgets. We would have no hesitation in recommending him to others.

02Upstairs shower room, complete re‑fit

Daniel is an excellent fitter who also provided some excellent design inspiration. It's not really like having a tradesman in the house, more like a family friend who is doing some work for you.

A 100% positive experience. The finish on both the bathrooms was excellent and on budget.

03Broken shower head fitting

Prompt, polite and professional. Only a small job but done quickly, at a reasonable price, and very well. I have already passed his number on to a neighbour. Thanks.

04Refit bath, install shower, build small wall, fit panelling

Dan was very thorough, professional and polite. He explained everything and worked hard to ensure our bathroom was completed within the planned time despite a few unexpected problems on the way. This also applied to the tradesmen who worked with him.

The finished result is superb and has elevated our previously standard bathroom to new levels of style and functionality. The devil is always in the detail and that is the difference with DP Bathrooms. I would not hesitate to recommend Dan and his team to anyone.

05Complete bathroom refit

DP Bathrooms were hired to replace a tired bathroom in its entirety. This included the addition of a heated towel rail, shower pump and lighting. Throughout the initial period Dan was excellent in helping us with our choice of tiles, bathroom designs etc. including running through the items we were looking to purchase online.

We asked for the job to be completed within a tight time slot. Despite our demands asking a lot, Dan was extremely accommodating and managed not only to complete the job on time but also gave us a chance to decorate before adding the radiator.

Whilst completing the job I noticed that our kitchen sink was cracked. Dan kindly sourced a sink of the correct dimensions (it was not a common shape) and taps, installing them for us before we moved in also. We found Dan and his workman to be courteous, diligent and organised throughout the job, making a stressful time worry free. Would definitely hire him again.

06Leaking toilet cistern

A very nice young man, left everywhere clean, knew what he was doing and did everything with confidence. I am having him back to do another project in the new year.

07Moving pipes in an airing cupboard and moving a radiator

The quote and work was arranged quickly. Dan's responses were quick and he didn't string us along like many other plumbers we had contacted.

The work was carried out and he raised any issues with us as he went along, to make sure we were happy with the work.

08Installation of a new en‑suite

Dan was a pleasure to have working on our project, great attention to detail and fantastic finished product. Would highly recommend and welcome back.

09Refurbished en‑suite and bathroom

Dan quoted the work needed in detail and in a professional manner. Dan was diligent and detailed in all he did. He managed the project planning with electrical and tiling organisation. I am very pleased with the outcome.
